items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself: 'My name is Monk Rowe for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.'

ctx.x: Joe was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 17, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We are in Clearwater Beach. My name is Monk Rowe for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m pleased to have Joe Ascione here.
